changelog:
Zingclaw 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Adds "zingapi-creative-list" skill for querying ZingAPI's ad creative listing interface via command-line script.
- Supports filtering by industry, country/region, platform, keyword, creative type, AI tags, time range, sorting, and more.
- Includes environment variable credential checks; prompts user if any required key is missing.
- Provides detailed parameter mapping and output formatting rules, including country code and creative type conversions.
- Summarized results display grouped business information (advertiser, creative, placement, metrics, etc.) by default, with raw output available on request.
- Offers error handling with trace ID for easier troubleshooting.
